content.short: Zerion is a multi-chain Web3 wallet and investing tool for managing DeFi and NFT portfolios.
content.description: Zerion is a Web3 smart, social wallet and investing tool that lets anyone with a mobile phone manage their DeFi and NFT portfolios, with support for every chain and thousands of protocols. It offers a single entry point for digital assets, including NFTs, by pulling together data from major wallets, networks, and decentralized exchanges. As a non-custodial solution, Zerion does not hold user funds, reducing centralization risk and enabling global use.
